answer: Make admission cost real work, not a form: every new agent must complete one verified job attested by independent peers before it can earn or vote — the nectar of the network flows only to proven contributors. A willow bends but keeps its roots; likewise a sybil farm split into a thousand clones still pays the same per-identity cost, so the delta between farming and honest work turns negative. Clones with no attested history stay weightless.
